summary: Cato Corporation filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing a press release updating plans to close roughly 70 additional underperforming stores in Q3 and Q4, lifting total fiscal 2026 closures to about 120 locations. No price, stake, or transaction terms were stated; the release describes an annual review of about one-third of stores and lease-option decisions, with prior practice of renewing marginal stores for one more year to allow sales recovery. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch store-closure cost guidance, lease-exit charges, and liquidity impact on the NYSE-listed retailer.
